notes.title: Gamestate Patch
notes.content:
[p]Found a few cases where the game would not synchronize some states.

(When a new player enters the lobby)
- Fixed a bug where the selected map would not sync.
- Fixed a bug where the selected mode would not sync in some cases.

Thanks to the players reporting on issues they find and making me aware of them.
This could be wrapped up to me being somewhat silly when rewriting code in the initialization stage for players joining the lobby.

Happy tumbling![/p]

notes.title: Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Fixed memory leak from projectiles not being cleaned up properly.
Improved networking efficiency for shooting projectiles.

Playing the game for a solid session would cause memory leaks building up ram usage.
Also, each projectile and their related particles now spawn using purely necessary data packed and sent over the network.
Any further increase in efficiency would come at a loss of data accuracy, wont go there unless its necessary.

notes.title: Skin Editor Patch + Rocket Jump
notes.content:
Fixed skin editor animation toggle not working on some clients.
Fixed skin editor where the skin would not update when editing the nozzle.

Skin editor frame rate option can no longer go below 1 FPS
Skin editor frame copy will now let you paste the copied skin in a much more readable format to allow for easy sharing.

Optimized skin loading when joining a lobby, (Data transfer amount decreased by around 80%)

Weapon changes:
AOE Weapons now deal knock back to the shooter.
This lets players Rocket Jump with the rocket launcher.
Affected weapons: Grenade Launcher, Raygun and Rocket Launcher.

notes.title: Proximity voice chat
notes.content:
Proximity voice chat has been added.
People can now squeak and scream at each other in-game.
Proximity chat can be modified/changed by clicking on any player icon in the lobby where two of the pop-ups will allow for muting a player, and changing their volume.
Using the mute button on ones own icon will stop others from hearing the one muting themselves.
Self muting is persistent across games, meaning if you don't wish for people to hear you, you can use this toggle button once and forget about it.

Player icons will no longer be a redirect to their steam profile, this feature has been moved to a button pop-up that appears when you click on their icon.
The last pop-up element is only available to the host, allowing the host to kick a player from the lobby.

(Uncertain) 
Fixed a bug where player icons would not load when connecting to a lobby.
The system for synchronizing steam profile data has been rewritten, it should now be faster and hopefully be a fix for the issue where icons would not load upon lobby hopping/changing lobbies frequently.
